 TOP 10 UPCOMING GOVT JOBS 2026 OCT DEC 
 Top 10 Upcoming Govt Jobs 2026 Oct - Dec, 1 लाख पदों पर भर्ती
 Many government job opportunities are available in Railways and Uttar Pradesh government departments. Important recruitments include RRB NTPC Graduate, RRB NTPC Undergraduate, Station Master, UPPSC RO/ARO, UPPSC Inter Level, Assistant Teacher and TGT posts. Candidates should check the last date to apply, application fees, age limits and education requirements before filling out the application form.

 Top 10 Upcoming Govt Jobs 2026 Oct - Dec: The last three months of 2026 bring many government job opportunities for candidates. Different government departments are hiring candidates for various posts.
 The Railway Recruitment Board ( RRB ) and Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) have announced several recruitment opportunities. These jobs are available for candidates with different education levels.
 Candidates should know the important dates, fees, age limits and qualifications before applying. This will help them complete the application process correctly and on time.
  RRB NTPC (Graduate Level)
 The Railway Recruitment Board has announced vacancies for RRB NTPC Graduate posts. Candidates who have completed graduation can apply for these jobs.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: October 8
 Last Date to Apply: November 6
 Form Correction Dates: November 9 to November 18
 Expected Exam Date: Fourth week of December
 Exam City Details: 10 days before the exam
 Admit Card: 4 days before the exam
 Application Fees and Refund 
 General/OBC/EWS: ₹500 (₹400 refund after appearing in the exam).
 SC/ST/Reserved Categories: ₹250 (Full refund after appearing in the exam).
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Total Vacancies: 3,548
 Minimum Age: 18 years
 Maximum Age: 33 years
 Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.
 Education: Graduation from a recognised university in any subject.
 RRB NTPC (Undergraduate/12th Level)
 The RRB NTPC Undergraduate recruitment is for candidates who have passed Class 12. It offers entry-level job opportunities in the Indian Railways.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: October 15
 Last Date to Apply: November 13
 Last Date for Fee Payment: November 15
 Exam City Details: 10 days before the exam
 Admit Card: 4 days before the exam
 Application Fees and Refund 
 General/OBC/EWS: ₹500 (₹400 refund after appearing in the exam).
 SC/ST/Reserved Categories: ₹250 (Full refund after appearing in the exam).
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Total Vacancies: 1,688
 Education: Class 12 pass or equivalent qualification.
  RRB Station Master Recruitment
 The Indian Railways has announced recruitment for Station Master posts . Station Masters help manage railway station work and train operations.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: October 27
 Last Date to Apply: November 25
 Application Fees and Refund 
 General/OBC/EWS: ₹500 (₹400 refund after appearing in the exam).
 SC/ST: ₹250 (Full refund after appearing in the exam).
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Total Vacancies: 1,265
 Minimum Age: 20 years
 Maximum Age: 33 years
 Education: Graduation or the required qualification mentioned in the official notification.

 UPPSC Review Officer (RO) and Assistant Review Officer (ARO)
 The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has announced vacancies for Review Officer and Assistant Review Officer posts. These jobs involve office and document-related work in government departments.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: October 26
 Last Date to Apply: November 26
 Last Date for Fee Payment: November 26
 Last Date for Form Correction: December 3
 Exam Date: To be announced
 Application Fees 
 General/OBC/EWS: ₹125
 SC/ST: ₹65
 Physically Handicapped (PH): ₹25
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Total Vacancies: 501
 Minimum Age: 21 years
 Maximum Age: 40 years
 Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.
 UPPSC Inter Level (10+2) Recruitment
 This recruitment is for candidates who have passed Class 12. It offers opportunities for clerical and other office-related government jobs in Uttar Pradesh.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: November 10
 Last Date to Apply: December 1
 Last Date for Fee Payment: December 1
 Last Date for Form Correction: December 8
 Application Fees 
 General/OBC/SC/ST/PH: ₹25
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Expected Vacancies: 1,784
 Age Limit: The minimum age is 18 to 21 years, and the maximum age is 30 to 40 years, depending on the post.
 Education: Class 12 pass or the qualification mentioned in the official notification.
 Uttar Pradesh Assistant Teacher Recruitment
 The Uttar Pradesh government has announced recruitment for Assistant Teacher posts in government schools. These teachers will teach students at the primary and upper-primary levels.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: September 16
 Extended Last Date to Apply: November 4
 Last Date for Fee Payment: November 4
 Exam Dates: December 3 and December 4
 Admit Card: 4 to 7 days before the exam
 Application Fees 
 General/Unreserved: ₹1,000
 SC/ST: ₹500
 Physically Handicapped (PH): ₹300
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Total Vacancies: 12,405
 Minimum Age: 21 years
 Maximum Age: 40 years
 Maximum Age for Certain Categories/Posts: Up to 62 years, as per the rules.
 Education: Candidates must have the required teaching qualification mentioned in the official notification.
 Uttar Pradesh TGT (Trained Graduate Teacher) Recruitment
 The Uttar Pradesh government is hiring teachers for TGT posts. Selected candidates will teach different subjects in secondary schools.
 Important Dates 
 Application Start Date: October 24
 Last Date to Apply: November 23
 Form Correction Date: November 26
 Exam Dates: December 23 and December 24
 Application Fees 
 General/Unreserved: ₹1,000
 SC/ST: ₹500
 Eligibility and Vacancies 
 Total Vacancies: 17,735
 Minimum Age: 21 years
 Education: Graduation and the required teaching qualification for the selected subject, as mentioned in the official notification.
 Other Upcoming Government Job Notifications
 In addition to the above recruitments, candidates can also prepare for other upcoming government jobs.
 UP Police Recruitment 
 The UP Police recruitment notification is expected in the coming months.
 Around 32,000 or more vacancies are expected.
 Candidates should wait for the official notification for exact details.
 SSC Recruitment
The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) also conducts several government job exams. Candidates can prepare for:
 SSC CGL 
 SSC CHSL 
 SSC MTS 
 SSC GD 
 SSC Stenographer 
 Candidates should check the official SSC exam calendar for new notifications and exam dates.How to Prepare for Upcoming Government Jobs?
 Good preparation is important to clear government exams. Candidates should study all important subjects and practise questions regularly.

 What is the RRB application fee refund policy?
 General, OBC and EWS candidates need to pay ₹500. They can get ₹400 back after appearing in the exam. SC, ST and reserved category candidates need to pay ₹250 and can get the full amount back after appearing in the exam. What is the age limit for RRB NTPC Graduate and Undergraduate posts?
 The minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age is 33 years for both posts. SC/ST candidates get 5 years of age relaxation, while OBC candidates get 3 years. How many vacancies are available for UP Assistant Teacher and TGT recruitment?
 There are 12,405 vacancies for UP Assistant Teacher posts and 17,735 vacancies for UP TGT posts. What is the last date to apply for UPPSC RO and ARO recruitment?
 The last date to submit the online application and fee is November 26. The form correction window closes on December 3. What is the eligibility for RRB Station Master recruitment?
 Candidates must have a graduate degree and be between 20 and 33 years of age. The application process runs from October 27 to November 25. Table of Content RRB NTPC (Graduate Level)
